answer.text:
Intel Foundry’s external revenue fell from **$953 million in 2023 to $385 million in 2024**, a decline of **$568 million**.

Calculation: \((953 - 385) / 953 \times 100 \approx 59.6\%\), or **about 60%**.

Intel attributed the decline primarily to **lower traditional packaging services revenue and lower equipment sales**. (Accession **0000050863-25-000009**, “Operating Segment Revenue Summary,” chunk **12**; “A Year in Review,” chunk **7**.)
